blocks.text: If you’re here, you’re ready for something to change, and you want a truly personalised life changing retreat experience - where you are the only guest.

Alive Luxury Retreats is a private, five-star luxury retreat designed for individuals who expect complete discretion, personalised care, and real results. This is one-on-one, fully confidential, and built entirely around you.

Since 2009, we have been trusted by VIPs, executives, high networth families, and high-performing individuals seeking a more advanced approach to wellness, detox, burnout recovery, and mental health. Every private retreat is delivered in your own luxury retreat villa or private 5 star residence, with a dedicated expert team working exclusively with you at every stage.

links.text: luxury retreat villa or private 5 star residence

blocks.text: This is not a group retreat, and it is not a generic wellness program.

Your experience is tailored across your health, your mind, and your life. From advanced health rejuvenation, detox and biohacking to full burnout recovery and mental health support, every element is designed to help you reset, regain clarity, and create lasting change.

Our proven 360 proven system combines advanced wellness, powerful coaching, therapy, and full life integration. You don’t just feel better while you’re here, you return to your life with a new way of thinking, living, and showing up.
Alive exists for those who value privacy, excellence, and a truly personalised experience, and who are ready to invest in themselves at the highest level.

blocks.text: Personalised One on One Program and Attention
intelligent, personalised wellbeing in your very own one on one retreat

At Alive, no two guests arrive for the same reason and no two experiences are ever the same. Guests come seeking rest, clarity, renewal, direction, health, inspiration or simply space. What sets Alive apart is our ability to see beyond the surface of what you ask for and understand what you actually need. Through time, care and highly skilled discernment, we curate a truly holistic wellness experience around the individual, not a preset program. This level of personalisation, depth and attention is what defines Alive as the only high-end luxury holistic wellness and mental health retreat in the world operating at this level. Here, wellness is not prescribed or packaged. It is intelligently designed, thoughtfully delivered and seamlessly woven into a refined luxury retreat experience that supports meaningful, lasting wellbeing.

blocks.text: At Alive, change across all areas of life happens quickly, because we work differently.

Your retreat is designed to address every part of you at the same time. Your physical health, your nervous system, your mental and emotional state, your habits, your relationships, and the way you live your life are all supported together, creating a level of change that feels immediate and deeply felt.

With a highly personalised one-on-one approach and a dedicated expert team working around you, you are immersed in an environment where everything is aligned to support your transformation. You are not waiting for results. You are experiencing them as they happen. Your sleep improves, your energy returns, your mind settles, and you begin to feel like yourself again, often within days.

Because nothing is treated in isolation, the results go far beyond how you feel during your stay. What changes here carries forward into your life. The way you think, the way you respond, the way you move through your day begins to shift in a way that is sustainable and lasting.
This is the true meaning of a holistic approach. Not surface level, but complete. Not slow, but deeply effective.
This is where real change happens, and where it holds.

Trusted By VIP's Since 2009
Private, confidential, one on one retreats for those leading demanding lives and carrying real responsibility

Since 2009, Alive has worked with executives, CEOs, entrepreneurs, high net worth individuals, and families who require complete discretion, trust, and a level of care that reflects the way they live and the level they operate at.

Alive was not created as a concept. It was built from lived experience, from understanding what it feels like to be under constant pressure, to carry responsibility at a high level, and to reach a point where something needs to change, properly and without compromise.
This understanding shapes everything we do.

We know the reality behind high performance lives. The expectations, the decisions, the responsibility for others, and the fact that there is often no space to stop, reset, and be supported in a way that truly works.
You are met with a team who understands how to work at this level, with professionalism, discretion, and precision.

Many of our clients come to us at pivotal moments. When something is no longer sustainable, or when they are ready to take their life, health, or performance to a different level, without stepping away from who they are or what they have built.
You are supported in a way that respects your life, your position, and the people around you, while giving you the space to reset, regain control, and move forward with clarity and strength.

blocks.text: When you come to Alive, your wellbeing is supported by a hand-picked team of world-class professionals chosen for depth, integrity and the ability to work with people at a very human level. Every role matters. Every person is there for a reason. Together, they create the safety, care and consistency that allows you to truly let go and receive.
Your Alive team includes:
5-Star Service & Hospitality Team Attentive, discreet support that ensures you feel cared for, comfortable and completely at ease throughout your stay.
Health & Vitality Team Supporting physical health, energy, balance and long-term wellbeing.
Movement & Body Specialists Yoga, pilates, fitness and restorative movement taught with ease, safety and intelligence.
Emotional Wellbeing Practitioners Highly skilled professionals supporting emotional release, resilience and inner balance.
Inner Calm & Mindfulness Guides Meditation, breathwork and healing practitioners helping you slow down and reconnect within.
Recovery & Regeneration Specialists Supporting deep rest, recovery and nervous system restoration.
Spa & Bodywork Therapists Delivering nurturing, restorative and healing treatments with care and precision.
Nature & Cultural Guides Thoughtful facilitation of nature immersion and cultural experiences that ground and restore.
You are supported by a cohesive, experienced team that works together seamlessly so you can feel safe, held and fully supported.
